Name: Turn-Based Combat
Author: GoodSmarts
Description:
[center][b][size=4]I did [i]not[/i] know about [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45879]Combatplus[/url] when I uploaded this. If you want a more in-depth system, try that one out. This one is intended to be simplistic and based off vanilla stats, if that's more your jam.[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][youtube]cDYdVTKlU2Y[/youtube][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Features ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds a turn-based combat system, which triggers whenever you make direct contact with an enemy. You can still use weapons out of combat and fight like vanilla, but instead of getting hit, you're taken to a battle screen. Spend energy to use abilities during turn-based. Some special abilities can increase enemy item drops and Combat XP gained, so even though you can kill enemies outside of turn-based combat, you may find it beneficial to do turn-based anyway.

I designed sound effects for entering battle, winning a battle, and made battle music for during the fights. Volumes of all three are configurable with GMCM.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#D4D4D8]If you go into the mod and replace the sounds in the assets folder, you can add your own sound effects and battle theme. The README.txt contains the proper file format you need.[/color]

In battle, you have some options:
[list=1]
[*]Attack[/*]
[*]Dodge[/*]
[*]Abilities[/*]
[*]Item[/*]
[*]Limit[/*]
[*]Flee[/*]
[/list]Your initial equipped weapon for the battle is whatever you had selected in your hotbar when the battle began. If it wasn't a weapon, you will attack with your fists. To equip a new weapon, choose [b]"Item"[/b] and select one. The enemy gets a turn after you equip or use an item.

[b]Dodge[/b] costs 5 energy but grants an 80% to avoid enemy attacks for two turns.

The [b]Abilities[/b] button opens a menu where you can choose from 5 different abilities unique to whatever weapon-type you're holding (Sword, Club, Dagger). New abilities are unlocked based on your vanilla Combat skill at levels 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. Abilities cost energy, and some abilities can add status effects to yourself or to enemies.

When you take damage, your [b]Limit[/b] meter fills, à la Final Fantasy. Once it's full, you can use a Limit Break ability. You can hold onto it between battles.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b]Most enemies have unique actions[/b] they may use during their fight. There are some pretty unique effects for some of them and a good deal of flavor text, à la Dragon Quest. They can inflict status effects on you or themselves.

If GMCM is installed, there's also an options button on the bottom right of the battle menu. From there, you can disable the mod entirely, adjust sound effect/music volume, or adjust the delay between actions during battle.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=2]One little note: Enemies that are meant to be invulnerable (like Mummies or Armored Bugs) can be killed if you defeat them in turn-based combat.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]Related: If an enemy can't damage you in real-time vanilla combat (like a Mummy on the floor), they will not be able to attack you during turn-based.[/size][/left]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Requirements ---[/size][/b][/center]
[center][left]The only requirement is SMAPI.[/left]
[left]However, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is highly recommended.[/left]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Compatibility ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]MULTIPLAYER NOT TESTED. MIGHT WORK, MIGHT BE BUGGY.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[center][left][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]MOBILE NOT TESTED - 99.9% CHANCE IT WON'T WORK.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Incompatible with Combatplus, for obvious turn-based reasons. [/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left]Compatible with modded enemies and weapons.[/left]
[left]Compatible with Fashion Sense outfits.[/left]
[left]Compatible with controller or keyboard inputs.[/left]
[left]Safe to install or uninstall mid-playthrough.[/left]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=6][b]--- My Thoughts ---[/b][/size][/center]
[center][left]Is it balanced? Probably not. Does it fit with Stardew Valley's regular gameplay? No lol. Should it be a staple in Stardew Nexus Collections, or anyone's regular modlist? Probably not. Are the battles extremely short with a good weapon, forcing you to listen to first 3 seconds of the battle theme over and over again? Yes, but that's a staple of old-school JRPGs, and at least you can turn the music off.

It's really more for the novelty. Stardew's art style is very similar to old-school 16-bit graphics and JRPGs of that era, so I thought it might be neat if it had that battle system too.[/left]

[b][size=6]--- AI Disclaimer ---[/size][/b]
[left]Very sorry to disappoint, but this mod [b]was vibe-coded[/b] with Claude; I'll admit to it for the sake of transparency. I came up with all the abilities, mechanics, menus, text, and visuals, while Claude did the code. It's not going to be better than what a real modder can make. [b]The music and sound effects are NOT made with AI. [/b]Absolutely [b]no AI[/b] was used making them.[b] [/b]I made them myself in FL Studio the morning of writing this. Self-admittedly, I'm not a developer, but I am a musician.[/left]
[/center]

Added:
- Energy use
- Limit Breaks
- 15 Unique Weapon Abilities (5 per type)
- Enemy Abilities (unique to each enemy)
- Status Effects
- Scrollable battle log
- Various graphical changes
